detailed_description: The Bar Chart Generator is a client-side web application that enables programmatic creation of vertical/horizontal bar charts using HTML5 Canvas and SVG rendering. Built on a reactive JavaScript framework, it accepts JSON/CSV data inputs, maps numeric values to visual dimensions (bar height/width), and supports multi-series comparisons with stacked/grouped configurations. Professionals use this tool to visualize quantitative comparisons across categorical variables for business intelligence dashboards, academic research papers, and technical documentation. The engine supports logarithmic scaling, axis reversal, and custom color mapping via HEX/RGB inputs with real-time DOM updates. Charts are exported as resolution-independent SVG vectors or raster PNGs with adjustable DPI. Data validation occurs through schema parsing, ensuring correct dimensionality before rendering.
usage_steps: Select data format (JSON array or CSV) in the Input Format dropdown menu
Enter comma-separated values in the Data Input panel using format: category,value[,series]
Map X/Y axes using the Dimension Selector with categorical/numerical axis toggles
Customize bar styling through the Color Configuration panel using HEX codes
Adjust chart layout using the Axis Scaling slider for linear/logarithmic transforms
Export final visualization via PNG Export Button or SVG Code Copy function
usage_examples: Marketing teams visualizing monthly sales comparisons across regional branches
Data scientists demonstrating algorithm performance benchmarks in research papers
Web developers integrating responsive SVG charts into documentation portals
Financial analysts comparing quarterly revenue across multiple business units
